🚨🇲🇽 <u>Sheinbaum Orders a Security Plan for Morelos: More National Guard, a Stronger State Police</u>

After blockades and burned vehicles paralyzed towns in eastern Morelos, President Sheinbaum met the Security Cabinet with Governor Margarita González Saravia and ordered a plan to reinforce the state and municipal police, backed by more National Guard and armed forces and extra federal resources. A special team will go after the main generators of violence, and the state prosecutor's office will be strengthened. Morelos has one month to deliver the proposal, with the staff and funding it needs.
banner: MORELOS: FEDERAL SECURITY PLAN IN 30 DAYS

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Mexican Factories Produced 4.1% More in August</u>

Mexico's manufacturing output rose 1.7% from July and 4.1% from August 2025, according to INEGI's monthly manufacturing survey, despite Washington's tariffs. Petroleum products were among the gainers. Jobs are another story: factory employment fell 0.1% in the month and 1% over the year, and real pay slipped 0.2%. Factory payrolls have now shrunk for 42 straight months.

🇲🇽💰 <u>Mexico Caps Big Companies' Tax Deductions. PRI and PAN Vote No</u>

Mexico's Chamber of Deputies passed President Sheinbaum's Income Tax (ISR) reform 322–115, over the votes of PAN, PRI and MC. Companies earning over 50 million pesos a year would face limits: net interest deductions fall from 30% to 20% of taxable profit, and past losses can offset at most 50% of profits. Small farmers' exemption rises to 1 million pesos. The bill now goes to the Senate. Morena's Claudia Rivera: "The strategy to fight tax evasion is what has the opposition so angry."
banner: ISR REFORM: BIG FIRMS' DEDUCTIONS CAPPED

🇲🇽🌊 <u>Mexico Redraws the Gillnet Ban to Save the Vaquita</u>

Semarnat published new fishing rules for the northern Gulf of California in the DOF on October 14: an updated zone where gillnets are banned, satellite monitoring of boats kept in place, and new landing sites and fishing hours. The measures follow CITES recommendations and the scientific committee for the vaquita's recovery (CIRVA), and focus protection where the world's most endangered porpoise has actually been recorded.

🇲🇽🌽 <u>Debts Wiped for 3,418 Veracruz Farmers</u>

The federal program Volver a Crecer has freed Veracruz farmers from more than 450 million pesos in historic debts owed to the defunct rural lender FND. Of 4,160 borrowers in the state, 3,418 had their debts fully settled; the other 742 got a 30% discount and a restructuring. The program is run by INDEP, the Institute to Return to the People What Was Stolen, and covers loans made unpayable by piled-up interest, the pandemic and drought.
banner: VERACRUZ: 450M PESOS OF FARM DEBT WIPED

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Morena Mayor of Puerto Aventuras Arrested for Extortion</u>

Quintana Roo's prosecutors arrested Gilberto Gómez Martínez, the Morena mayor of Puerto Aventuras, on a judge's warrant for aggravated extortion, along with his nephew and an official from the town's economic development office. They are accused of threatening a local merchant: pay up, or lose your goods and your business.

🇲🇽🎓 <u>"El Negro" Durazo's Mansion Becomes a Public University</u>

Arturo "El Negro" Durazo ran Mexico City's police under López Portillo and built himself a mansion in Tlalpan that became a byword for that era's corruption. President Sheinbaum announced it will now house a campus of the public Universidad Rosario Castellanos plus a high school, with 150 million pesos for the conversion and classes starting in 2027. 3,067 students have already registered for its five degrees: psychology, law and criminology, administration, tourism and economics.

🔥🇲🇽 "They talk about freedom. Which freedom? The one they have to rant, because the only thing there is, is debate. Censorship? There is none." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 15, 2026 Sheinbaum said some businessmen "who spend their time ranting through their television network" oppose the government's model: "for the good of all, the poor first," shared prosperity and distribution of wealth. "They want to accumulate more for themselves, and nothing for the people," and they oppose the well-being programs and the wage increase. She said she meets regularly with the Business Coordinating Council and the Mexican Business Council, and sometimes tells them no. One example was a proposal to stop wage increases. The monthly minimum wage has gone from 2,800 pesos in 2018 to more than 13,500 today.

🇲🇽🔍 "There has to be recognition, because there has not been that recognition as such." "The first is recognition by the Mexican State of the forced disappearance of that era, ordered from the highest spheres of power." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, Oct 15, 2026 On Aug 26 a judge ordered the Defense Ministry to hand over information on Alicia de los Ríos, a member of the Liga Comunista 23 de Septiembre who disappeared in 1978. Sheinbaum said the ministry has to respond to the judge. The government has met four times with Eureka, the collective of Rosario Ibarra de Piedra, and is working on three fronts: state recognition, truth and justice, and finding the disappeared. Attorney General Ernestina Godoy appointed a new prosecutor for victims of the Dirty War.
banner: DIRTY WAR: THE STATE MUST RECOGNIZE IT
